## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated; they run **offline** (no network, see CONTRIBUTING)
- [ ] Ran the suites I touched, plus `e2e/`
- [ ] No new secret, key or token in the diff
- [ ] Any new outbound URL/host is validated with `yantracore.netguard`
- [ ] Schema change = new numbered file in `supabase/` (never edit an applied one)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible or security-relevant changes
- [ ] Spec-facing change? Cite the VDA 5050 section it follows
